name: surf-workspace
description: SURF Research Cloud workspace status in Claude Code: status line, pane with start/stop, toast when a resume fails

api_token.title: SURF Research Cloud API token
api_token.description: Personal API token from portal.live.surfresearchcloud.nl > Profile > API tokens. Empty: SURF_RC_TOKEN or the macOS keychain item surf-research-cloud

workspace.title: Workspace name filter
workspace.description: Only show workspaces whose name contains this text; empty shows all your Compute workspaces

poll_seconds.title: Poll interval while idle (s)
poll_seconds.description: How often to check while nothing is changing; during resume/pause it checks every 10 s

resume_warn_minutes.title: Warn after resuming for (min)
resume_warn_minutes.description: Toast when a workspace is still resuming after this many minutes (often: no GPUs free)

notify_macos.title: macOS notification
notify_macos.description: Also raise a macOS notification when a resume succeeds or fails
